entries.en: All the members I met up[n]with today do seem happy...
I should check up on the[n]other members tomorrow...
Ryuji seemed sincerely happy[n]about being able to run with[n]his fellow track team...
Ann seemed happy to be[n]with Shiho, who is able to[n]continue playing volleyball...
Yusuke seemed happy about his[n]mother's work, "Sayuri," being[n]recognized as a work of art.
Makoto seemed happy being[n]able to spend time with both[n]her father and sister...
Futaba seemed happy being able to[n]spend her daily life with both her mother[n]and Sojiro, who she loves very much...
Haru seemed happy being able to[n]talk to her father without fear...
...But is this truly how[n]things should be?
I should check up on the[n]other members tomorrow...
